scope: Durable correction receipts, idempotent quota transactions and recovery after an accepted PR; isolated SQLite and PostgreSQL tests, with GitHub/provider fault injection.

publication.scope: Corrector implementation, migration, tests, verification UI/docs and prior validation evidence; unrelated worktree changes and line-ending-only changes are not included.

durable_contract.request_identity: Payer, project, action, normalized input and GitHub configuration; SHA-256 key, no credentials stored.
durable_contract.quota: UsageEvent and the operation's charged flag commit in one transaction. Both pre-commit rollback and lost post-commit acknowledgement are tested.
durable_contract.paid_previews: Saved before charging; replay or recovery returns the saved result without a new provider call or debit.
durable_contract.stale_previews: Source hashes reject a replay/application after the file changed. Confirmation reads the file at the exact base commit before creating its correction branch.
durable_contract.github_intent: Unique operation branch suffix, external-write intent and repair/task/billing intent are persisted before their effects.
durable_contract.pr_recovery: Read-only lookup by exact head/base, both repository identities, numeric PR number and expected GitHub URL. One confirmed matching PR is reused; no PR creation or file rewrite is repeated.
durable_contract.task_recovery: IssueTask records can be reconstructed from the persisted intent. PR SHA/node metadata is preserved and one verification trace is prepared outside the task loop.
durable_contract.unknown_outcomes: Missing, ambiguous, malformed or inaccessible PRs and partial branches are refused with 503. A changed request cannot bypass a pending payer operation.
durable_contract.automation: Recovery never merges or promotes a PR; restored verification does not grant automatic merge rights.

verified_scenarios: Repeated paid preview with the last credit
Saved preview after lost response following a committed charge
Preview reuse after a rolled-back quota transaction
Single quota debit despite lost post-commit acknowledgement
PR accepted before transport failure, then reused without another write
Keyword PR accepted before quota persistence failure: task rebuilt and one debit on recovery
Deleted or corrupted IssueTask metadata cannot permit a duplicate PR/preview
Unknown/empty/multiple PR matches, wrong branch/repository and malformed metadata fail closed
Interrupted partial branch cannot be retried by changing crawl timestamp
Source revision change cannot be overwritten by a saved paid preview
GitHub line-wrapped base64 content remains readable on preview replay
Copied thread context does not inherit journal write authority
Six simultaneous API processes share one last credit on real PostgreSQL
Existing SQLite database migration and create_all compatibility
Existing PostgreSQL schema upgraded from 0012 to 0013 and upgrade replay

full_local_suite.skip_note: Nine opt-in PostgreSQL guard cases and two PostgreSQL customer cases; all eleven passed in the separate PostgreSQL run.

verification.staged_semantic_check: Staged Python ASTs match the tested worktree; staged JSON parses successfully.

causes: Migration tests ran Alembic logging setup in the pytest process and disabled existing application loggers.
Source guard tests needed to explicitly account for the recovery verification trace, and the recovery helper had prepared it inside the task loop.
test_isolation_correction.fix: Run migration CLI in isolated child processes; prepare one recovery trace outside the loop and preserve the five primary PR-route assertions.

remaining_release_checks: Partial branches, provider crashes before a saved result, or unconfirmable PR outcomes require operator reconciliation; no automatic destructive cleanup or retry is enabled.
Exercise recovery against actual GitHub transport failures and real worker restarts, not only injected responses and database-level integration tests.
Validate production worker/pool capacity and session-compatible PostgreSQL pooling.
Define receipt retention and operator tooling for pending operations before broad commercial rollout.
Complete the remaining Claude-written families, description batches and indexability-sensitive positive controls.
Validate real customer onboarding and billing lifecycle, then review/deploy and supervise pilots.
